# Worktable masonry source

The recipe is exact generated JSON from Tinkers' Construct at
`f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`, under the existing TConstruct MIT
license and attribution. The manifest records its URL and SHA-256 hash.

The native recipe fingerprints exclude only `key.s`. They guard the existing
13 recipes' rock inputs, counts, output components and all other fields, rather
than claiming complete generic source retexturing support.
